description_ar: هوية إخبارية: شريط أحمر عاجل، عناوين بخط عريض، شريط سفلي للمراسل، حركة سريعة ونظيفة.
description_en: Broadcast-news identity: red breaking bar, bold headlines, lower-third name tags, clean fast motion.
scene_blueprint_en: Scene 1: BREAKING tag (white box, red text) + red headline bar sliding in, headline typewriter.
Scene 2: headline card with a vertical accent bar and a short summary.
Scene 3: reporter lower-third (name + title) sliding up from the bottom.
rules_en: Flat solid shapes (rect) for bars; no heavy glow.
Headlines right-aligned (align: right) for Arabic, max 2 lines.
Always include a thin accent bar at the bottom edge.
Red #ef4444 for urgency, amber #fbbf24 for highlights.
